settings.languageDescription: The language of the application interface.
settings.themeDescription: Light, dark navy, or AMOLED true black.
settings.yourNameDescription: Labels your microphone in transcripts as . Your audio is always tagged as you; other participants are labelled separately (“Guest”, and Speaker 1/2/3 once voice diarization is enabled).
settings.notificationsDescription: Enable or disable notifications of start and end of meeting
settings.storageDescription: View and access where Meetily stores your data
settings.storagePortableNote: Portable core data: Models, database, and templates use Meetily’s app data folder. Recordings stay in the user-facing folder shown above so they remain easy to find, play, and back up.
settings.showConfidenceIndicatorsDescription: Display colored dots showing transcription confidence quality
settings.recordingDescription: Configure how your audio recordings are saved during meetings.
settings.autoSaveDescription: Automatically save audio files when recording stops
settings.micGainDescription: Boost your voice if it sounds quiet next to system audio (0.5×–3×)
settings.systemGainDescription: Balance other participants and computer audio (0.5×–3×)
settings.systemGainLimiterNote: If boosted audio repeatedly hits the safety limiter, the live system meter warns you to lower this gain or playback volume.
settings.fileNamePattern: Recordings are saved with timestamp: recording_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.{format}
settings.autoSaveDisabledNote: Audio recording is disabled. Enable “Save Audio Recordings” to automatically save your meeting audio.
settings.defaultAudioDevicesDescription: Set your preferred microphone and system audio devices for recording. These will be automatically selected when starting new recordings.
settings.postCallLoadFailed: Could not load the post-call model preference.
settings.vocabularyLoadFailed: Could not load the saved vocabulary.
settings.liveModelSaveFailed: Could not save the live transcription model
settings.liveTranscriptionDescription: Choose the model used while recording. Parakeet is recommended for most live meetings; Whisper remains available when its extra language and vocabulary controls matter more than speed.
settings.parakeetLiveDescription: Best for live meetings: lower latency, lighter resource use, and strong real-time accuracy. Parakeet does not support custom vocabulary hints.
settings.whisperLiveDescription: Best as a post-call second pass. Whisper is slower and heavier during live meetings, but supports vocabulary hints, manual language selection, and broad multilingual transcription.
settings.usesWhisperModel: Uses Whisper: {model}. Change the specific model under Manage Whisper models below.
settings.installWhisperForUse: Install Whisper for post-call or live use
settings.postCallDescription: Choose the default for automatic enhancement after recording. You can still override it for each meeting.
settings.whisperPostCallDescription: Best for post-call quality. Whisper is slower and uses more resources, but can improve difficult names, jargon, and multilingual audio. It uses your global vocabulary hints below to guide names, acronyms, and technical terms.
settings.parakeetPostCallDescription: Finishes post-call enhancement sooner and uses fewer resources while maintaining strong accuracy. It does not use global vocabulary hints.
settings.postCallFollowsLive: This currently follows your live model. Choosing either card makes post-call selection independent.
settings.vocabularyActiveDescription: Help Whisper recognize names, companies, products, acronyms, and technical terms in live or post-call transcription. Whisper uses up to 224 prompt tokens.
settings.vocabularyInactiveDescription: These hints become available when Whisper is selected for live or post-call transcription.
settings.diarizationDescription: Labels your transcript with Speaker 1/2/3… by analyzing voices in the recording. Runs entirely on-device. Open a meeting and click Speakers above the transcript to run it.
settings.diarizationBundled: Models ship with the app — nothing to download.
settings.diarizationRepairNote: The bundled speaker models couldn’t be found. You can re-download them{size} from this app’s GitHub release — files are verified with SHA-256.
settings.diarizationOverrideNote: Drop your own <c>segmentation-3.0-fp16.onnx</c>, <c>wespeaker-resnet34-LM.onnx</c> and <c>xvec_transform.npz</c> here to override the bundled models.
settings.diarizationCredits: Models: pyannote <c>segmentation-3.0</c> (MIT) · WeSpeaker ResNet34 (Apache-2.0) · VBx x-vector transform (Apache-2.0). Credit to their respective authors.
settings.diarizationInstalledDescription: You can now use Speakers on any meeting with a recording.
settings.summaryLanguageDescription: Pin one language as the default for new meetings. Unpinned languages remain as quick-switch options in the summary generator. Auto uses the dominant transcript language.
settings.summaryLanguagePinnedNote: Default: {language} — click it again to unset. Max 5 quick-switch options.
settings.summaryLanguageNoPinNote: Click any language to set it as your default. Max 5 quick-switch options.
